pages.label: How It Works
pages.title: How Charms Work
pages.intro: Welcome! A charm is how we celebrate something you've done. Every achievement in this guide has its own charm, and each page that follows shows what it takes to earn it.

sections.heading: Pick a goal
sections.text: Look through the Table of Contents. Each page is one charm, or a small group of charms, with the steps to earn it.

sections.heading: Do the work
sections.text: Follow the steps on the page. Ask your mentor or a staff member anytime you have a question.

sections.heading: Report it
sections.text: When you have unlocked an achievement, turn in the small sheet. You'll find it in your mentor's bow folder at events. The Reporting Your Achievements page has the details.

sections.heading: Collect your charm and tickets
sections.text: Once an achievement is recorded, the charm is yours, along with any tickets listed at the top of its page. Spend them at the Arrow Store!

sections.heading: Good to know
sections.text: Attendance charms are counted for you automatically. You don’t need to report those.

pages.label: How It Works
pages.title: Types of Charms
pages.intro: Charms come in a few different kinds. Here is a quick look at each one, and the tickets that come with it.

sections.heading: Major Targets – 200 tickets
sections.text: Big life goals, like graduating, getting a job, or earning your driver’s license.

sections.heading: Minor Targets – 30 tickets
sections.text: Smaller goals and skills that help you grow along the way.

sections.heading: Bullseye Award – 200 tickets
sections.text: A special award with words written just for you. Each person can earn one.

sections.heading: Attendance Charms
sections.text: Charms for showing up. The ticket values vary, and these are counted for you automatically.

pages.label: How It Works
pages.title: Types of Charms
pages.intro: You can earn charms in two ways: through the big goals you are still chasing, and through the ways you give back as a volunteer.

sections.heading: Major Targets – 200 tickets
sections.text: Big life goals, like graduating, getting a job, or earning your driver’s license.

sections.heading: Attendance
sections.text: Charms for coming to events as a volunteer, including Bronze, Silver, Gold, and 5 in a Row.

sections.heading: Service & Leadership
sections.text: Charms for giving your time and skills, like volunteering 100 hours, teaching, or leading a club.

sections.heading: Mentoring
sections.text: Charms for mentoring, like being a Co-Mentor or having a Golden Match.

sections.heading: Safety & Training
sections.text: Background checks and trainings that keep everyone safe, like Mandated Reporter and CPR Certified.

sections.heading: Connection
sections.text: Charms for connecting online and referring a new volunteer.

pages.label: How It Works
pages.title: Tickets & the Arrow Store
pages.intro: Many charms come with tickets. Save them up and spend them on awesome prizes!

sections.heading: Earn tickets
sections.text: Each charm's page shows how many tickets it is worth. Major Targets are worth 200 and Minor Targets 30.

sections.heading: Spend them at the Arrow Store
sections.text: We bring the Arrow Store to almost every event. Trade your tickets for prizes. Many of the prizes were requested by Arrows!

sections.heading: Add to the wishlist
sections.text: Want a prize we do not have yet? Add it to the wishlist at the Arrow Store, or text us at 805‑328‑0970.

sections.heading: When you turn 18
sections.text: Join the Arrow Alumni Launch Program and cash out your tickets at half their value, to pay for things that help you hit your Major Targets. 1,000 tickets = $500.

pages.label: How It Works
pages.title: Using Your Tickets
pages.intro: As an Arrow Alum, you can use your tickets in two ways: at the Arrow Store, or by cashing them out through the Arrow Alumni Launch Program (AALP).

sections.heading: Shop at the Arrow Store
sections.text: We bring the Arrow Store to almost every event. Trade your tickets for awesome prizes, just like Arrows do.

sections.heading: Add to the wishlist
sections.text: Want a prize we do not have yet? Add it to the wishlist at the Arrow Store, or text us at 805‑328‑0970.

sections.heading: Or cash out at half value
sections.text: AALP lets you cash out your tickets at half of their value for essentials that help you hit your Major Targets, like tuition, car insurance, and more.

sections.heading: You still earn tickets
sections.text: Major Targets are worth 200 tickets each, so every target you hit adds to what you can spend or cash out.

sections.heading: Learn more about AALP
sections.text: AALP offers mentorship, job opportunities, driver’s license help, and support with transportation.

pages.label: How It Works
pages.title: Reporting Your Achievements
pages.intro: Unlocked something? We want to celebrate it! Here is how to make sure it gets recorded.

sections.heading: Find the small sheet
sections.text: Small sheets are handed out at events and are kept in your mentor's bow folder.

sections.heading: Turn it in
sections.text: Turn in the small sheet at the check-in table to report the achievements you have unlocked.

sections.heading: Missing a charm?
sections.text: If a charm you earned has not shown up, text the For the Need phone to report it.
